review: The native source stores display hue and process-local audio handles in the following AI array slots. These values do not control damage, motion, collision or lifetime. All other recorded fields are compared exactly. Raw values remain in the traces.

fields.name: RainbowCrystalExplosion
fields.source: AI style 123 supplies rgbToHsl(Main.DiscoR/G/B). AI style 112 and DoRainbowCrystalStaffExplosion consume the value with hslToRgb for color and lighting.

fields.name: MonkStaffT2Ghast
fields.source: Stores PlayTrackedSound(DD2_GhastlyGlaiveImpactGhost).ToFloat(); used only by GetActiveSound to move or invalidate the audio handle.

fields.name: DD2PhoenixBowShot
fields.source: Stores PlayTrackedSound(DD2_PhantomPhoenixShot).ToFloat(); used only by GetActiveSound to move or invalidate the audio handle.

fields.name: WeatherPainShot
fields.source: Stores PlayTrackedSound(DD2_BookStaffTwisterLoop).ToFloat(); used only by GetActiveSound to set audio position/volume or invalidate the handle.

regressionChecks: Each listed exclusion is tested. Damage changes and changes to the same AI slots on other projectile types still fail.
